records.real_world_identity_notes: The PMR entry 911 Carrera Cup (964), with 265 hp and five forward gears, is best identified as the inaugural 1990 Porsche 911 Carrera 2 Cup of the 964 generation. Porsche identifies the first Cup car as a 1990 964-based 911 Carrera 2 Cup; Porsche's model-year table distinguishes the 1990–1991 M30/01, G50/03 five-speed car from the later 1992–1993 M64/03, G50/10 cars. The simulator does not expose a chassis number, so this is a model-year/specification identity rather than a unique historical chassis mapping.

The 265 hp value separates the early car from the 275 hp 1992–1993 version.
